title: L2 half fixed: all three hardcoded sed -n help ranges replaced by EDM-HELP-BEGIN/END sentinels plus an awk extractor, so the Output format and Exit codes contracts are reachable output again in edm-check-grants, run-eval.sh and score-artifacts.sh; edm-init and edm-validate-prefix gained help blocks
test:smoke-bash32 now uses apk add --no-cache jq git on the Alpine-based bash:3.2 image and asserts bash --version reports 3.2, so before_script succeeds and the job's script stage is reachable

L2 half fixed: all three CI status captures now initialise and use || var=$? (:347, :494, :552) so the BLOCKING-anomaly, structural-error and NOT ARMED branches are reachable, and run-eval.sh:443 captures git status separately instead of inside a heredoc; the run-eval.sh:452 porcelain rename mis-parse is the L1/L3 half and is out of L2 scope

the class-2 PCRE branch now reads two fields from the two-field grep -n, so the ignore-marker and code-fence suppression works for the unicode class on the GNU-grep branch CI takes, the snippet is populated and the path:line contract holds

the compute_cost_usd subsection now enumerates the eight actual arms in order and states the true diagnostic -- an unrecognized in-family generation falls to *) and warns -- matching bin/edm-state:368-427 arm for arm
regression check: the three die messages still carry their PREFIX, INIT_DIR and PATH_ARG interpolations at :373, :374 and :409

the closure message now reads the real prior verdict via jq '.verdict // .prior.verdict // "PARTIAL"' at :3342 and interpolates it at :3382, so a PASS- or FAIL-closed entry is no longer reported as was PARTIAL and the correct field is consulted
the --bare comment was rewritten to state why the flag is absent, so it now agrees with the NOTE at :294-296 and with the claude -p invocation at :285-293
the redundant prototype) case arm was deleted; the mode is rendered by a single unconditional ${mode} line, and every surviving prototype) arm in the file is materially distinct from its siblings

state_anomalies declares a local `found` accumulator and assigns it at twelve anomaly sites but never reads it and returns 0 unconditionally -- vestigial from the pre-T05 exit-code contract, and every anomaly class added since has copied the dead assignment forward

a self-test assertion whose condition is byte-identical to the branch-1 assertion at :212 against the same unchanged output, so it can never fail independently, prints nothing on success, and makes seven increment sites report against a hardcoded /6 denominator that D28 quotes as evidence

score_from_ratio clamps v to >= 0 at :145 and then tests (v < 0) at :147 in the same awk BEGIN block with no intervening assignment, so the negative-rounding arm of the ternary is unreachable for every input in the scorer's one shared normalizer

schema_at_least coerces sv through to_int with an explicit default at :922, which always prints a non-empty value, so the -z "$sv" disjunct at :923 can never be true -- residue left by the CA-001 remediation that inserted the coercion above the pre-existing guard

re-verified and NOT re-raised: compute_cost_usd still has no arm matching any live model, decisions.md D32 records this in full, leaves the recorded figures unrepriced per T52 AC9 and assigns verified Sonnet 5 / Fable 5 / Opus 5 rate rows to EDMV4 -- the disposition holds and CA-012 has now aligned the prose

re-verified: the tiered-versus-untiered section is still gated on .tiering_results with no producer (grep returns only the four sites inside this block); the in-code comment states it and decisions.md D28 records the matrix as built and deliberately not run pending D23's baseline
re-verified: pattern_target_heading_for still has a single *) arm, documented at :3585-3592 as the intentional extension point contractually coupled to adding a README mapping row

re-verified: the Edit arm's redundant _has_instruction=0 is documented at :486-493 as intentional -- Edit has no instruction-detection path by design and the resulting warning is advisory, never affecting the exit code

re-verified: cmd_migrate_schema's advance-by-one arithmetic is still a no-op today, retained as defence against schema_version 3 which CLAUDE.md records as deliberately unassigned; separately the comment at :1945-1948 misdescribes what happens to a coerced non-integer, which is L6 scope

re-verified: cmd_compare is still a second comparison implementation CI does not use, retained deliberately with the reason at :594-597, reachable via the --compare dispatch arm and exercised by wave7-smoke.sh
re-verified: the --*) unknown-flag guard still cannot see -h or --help because both exit at :70 -- a deliberate two-stage parse
